name: solo-website-system
description: Solo Website System (SWS): Cloudflare-native, Rust-powered open-source visual website builder.

scripts.render: cargo run -q -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality -- build packs/hospitality/demo/venue.json core/public
scripts.render:check: cargo run -q -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality -- build packs/hospitality/demo/venue.json core/public --check
scripts.codegen:check: cargo run -q --locked -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality,codegen --bin sws-codegen -- --check && cargo test -q -p sws-pack-hospitality --features jsonschema --locked --test venue_schema && cargo clippy --locked -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality,codegen --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked -p sws-pack-hospitality --features jsonschema --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.sites:check:headers: node core/tools/check-headers.mjs --headers-file sites/landing/public/_headers && node core/tools/check-headers.mjs --headers-file sites/docs/public/_headers
scripts.lint:abc: cargo run -q -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality -- check packs/hospitality/demo/venue.json
scripts.lint:clippy: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p sws-security -p sws-worker-site -p sws-wasm -p sws-assets -p sws-worker-studio -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p sws-worker-studio --features insecure-dev-auth -- -D warnings
scripts.studio:db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply STUDIO_DB --local -c wrangler.studio.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/studio-state
scripts.test:studio: node --test tests/unit/studio-registry.test.mjs tests/unit/studio-session-sql.test.mjs tests/unit/studio-release-guard.test.mjs tests/unit/studio-assets.test.mjs tests/unit/studio-auth.test.mjs tests/unit/studio-previews.test.mjs tests/unit/studio-publish-sql.test.mjs tests/unit/studio-deploy-sql.test.mjs
scripts.test:checkout: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.checkout.config.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run render:check && npm run codegen:check && npm run sites:check && npm run lint:abc && npm run lint:abc:fixture-negative && npm run check:headers && npm run sites:check:headers && npm run check:toolchain && npm run check:studio:release && npm run test:unit && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo test -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality --locked && npm run lint:clippy && cargo deny check
scripts.verify:full: npm run render:check && npm run codegen:check && npm run sites:check && npm run lint:abc && npm run check:headers && npm run sites:check:headers && npm run check:toolchain && npm run check:studio:release && npm run test:unit && npm run test:agents && npm run bootstrap:devvit && npm run test:devvit && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo test -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality --locked && npm run lint:clippy && cargo deny check
